source_state_return_fields.failure_rule: Any unknown semantic path, missing history/source, orphan parser/code artifact, unsafe path, broken receipt chain, incomplete rendered page set or head-registry mismatch remains a typed error. It is never emitted as coverage.

row_mapping.projection: Emit every parsed semantic JSON document, both actual ledgers, and every historical source-ledger snapshot. kind is the validated role/schema branch; sha256 is SHA-256 of exact bytes; json_text is exact UTF-8 decode of state.bytes[path], preserving optional-key presence and historical PDF bbox spelling.
row_mapping.trap: Do not reserialize parsed JSON through canonicalize; integer-only JCS cannot carry legacy contextual PDF bbox floats.

row_mapping.projection: record_path, record_schema, title, title_zh, authors, published_at, aliases, taxonomy, code_urls, source_ids and active extraction mirrors come directly from the validated paper record. v2 association_ids are source_associations[*].association_id; legacy association_ids is []; display_association_id is the selected display head association ID or null.
row_mapping.trap: Do not invent v2 association/display fields for legacy records and do not substitute selected display association for a cited historical association.

row_mapping.projection: record_path, canonical_repository, canonical_commit, paper_ids, officiality and license are exact record values; archived is record.get("archived") so old records expose null in the new row while documents preserves exact key presence.
row_mapping.trap: Repository identity must remain repo_id(record.canonical_repository), and _ownership rejects unknown paper_ids before projection.

row_mapping.projection: text is claim_ledger row.text; owner_kind/owner_id and page come from validated owners; reference is the exact owning paper section or repository capability reference; assessment/reviewed_at/risk/confidence/location preserve validated ledger values; head_event_id, head_event_sha256 and evidence_profile come from the validated assessment head and original evidence profile.
row_mapping.trap: There is exactly one canonical owner/reference and one validated terminal head. Missing, conflicting or defaulted lifecycle/assessment is an error; never derive authority from caller fields or display selection.

row_mapping.projection: Preserve the exact three-field wire object as wire and enumerate original zero-based order. Decode only transiently: Markdown uses decode_evidence plus its bound association; legacy PDF/code uses ledger_locator decoding. association_id is the Markdown locator's bound association ID and null for legacy PDF/code; display_association_id is independently derived from the owning paper's current display head and may be null.
row_mapping.resolution: Compute from retained bytes after source_state validation: Markdown resolve_markdown_locator(locator, association, exact raw bytes); PDF exact parser JSON pointer/page/text/optional charspan rules; code validate_code_locator(locator, unique inspected manifest, exact capture bytes) and return the same normalized line slice used by code_snippet_sha256.
row_mapping.trap: _locators validates ancestry and locator identity but does not produce the final excerpt. Never replace wire with decoded floats or let modern display selection authorize a legacy citation. Hash/span mismatch is SOURCE_CATALOG_EVIDENCE_INVALID; only otherwise valid unsupported legacy positions receive fixed unsupported reasons.

row_mapping.projection: row is the complete validated historical source-ledger row with original optional-key presence and arrays. Keep origin, content_kind, title, authority, review_status, content_sha256, dates, pages, independence_key and supersedes exactly as present; do not manufacture registration proof in this row.
row_mapping.trap: source-ledger history/receipt bindings are represented by basis, documents, snapshot ancestry and association registration objects; a legacy web-only source has no invented first-registration proof.

row_mapping.projection: path and sha256 bind the exact immutable source-version-association artifact; document is the exact validated association object, including raw capture, observation, registration and extraction references.
row_mapping.trap: The complete association set must match v2 paper source_associations and validate_source_inventory; do not project only the selected display version.

row_mapping.projection: path, sha256 and exact validated source-display-decision document; chain semantics are checked by derive_display_heads.
row_mapping.trap: Do not turn the derived display head into a new authority or discard historical decisions during rollback.

row_mapping.projection: event_id, event_sha256 and evidence_profile are exact derived head values. The event bytes are independently present in documents and checked by derive_assessment_heads/validate_claim.
row_mapping.trap: One head per claim is mandatory; stale or missing terminal history is a source/history error, not an unsupported assessment.

row_mapping.projection: head is the exact existing derived display-head row, including decision ID/hash, association reference and sequence. Null display selection emits no fabricated display-head row.
row_mapping.trap: The head is derived from the complete decision chain and is informational selection; it cannot replace citation association authority.

row_mapping.projection: Include every .raw/ inventory file, including captured files, source-ledger snapshots, parser/config/model/run files, code/alignment manifests and other derived material. kind is the validated path role; size_bytes and sha256 come from the complete inventory. source_ids is a sorted unique ancestry set from source origin/capture, run/parser ancestry and association links; unknown attribution is [].
row_mapping.trap: _legacy_artifacts requires parser/config/model sets to equal run ancestry and only error-free runs qualify documents; _code_groups requires exactly one manifest and alignment per repository and rejects orphan legacy code artifacts. Keep valid historical but unreferenced files visible.

row_mapping.projection: Emit the complete compiler output for wiki/papers, wiki/code and wiki/concepts paths with sha256 of exact bytes and text as strict UTF-8 decode.
row_mapping.trap: require_rendered=True compares actual page bytes to compile_pages and requires complete modern assessment/display head registries. Do not accept a semantic subset or compile under an unretained taxonomy resource.

row_mapping.projection: Emit exactly one row per registered source and one row per .raw artifact. A source is registered_owned when referenced by a canonical paper source_ids or repository claim evidence, otherwise registered_unclaimed. Captures are captured_registered when their exact path/hash is bound to a source row, otherwise captured_unregistered. Other .raw artifacts are derived_referenced when linked by canonical evidence ancestry, otherwise derived_unreferenced. source_ids/paper_ids/repo_ids are sorted unique derived sets; reason is the fixed profile string.
row_mapping.ordering: kind then id by exact UTF-8 bytes
row_mapping.trap: Coverage is not an orphan escape hatch. Malformed/missing history, unknown semantic paths, unsafe files and incomplete ancestry fail collection before a coverage row can be emitted.

r5_context_isolation.current_gap: contracts._registry is a process-global @lru_cache(maxsize=1), and canonical_compiler_v2.concept_items_for_papers reads taxonomy via live read_projection_resource_bytes. Hashing retained generation files separately cannot prove these cached/live consumers used the same captured bytes during one catalog reconstruction.
r5_context_isolation.proposed_shape: Add a private ContextVar-backed retained resource view entered only around one source-catalog reconstruction. The view exposes the complete captured schema registry, taxonomy/v1.json and catalog/profile bytes by logical resource name; resources readers and schema registry construction resolve only those retained bytes in the context. Build/cache the registry inside that context, invalidate only the private per-call context registry, preserve the unchanged default registry outside it, and do not monkeypatch globals.
required_safety: capture and retain package/repo resource ancestors, complete schema name set, file identities and bytes before projection
finally re-enumerate the same set and verify identities/bytes
no CWD fallback inside the retained view
generation change or registry add/remove wins WORK_PATH_UNSAFE over ordinary projection errors
do not claim R1 17-path closure until the R5 two-path amendment is frozen and independently reviewed

integration_traps: Do not call collect_source_state with allow_legacy_structural=True; the catalog requires complete rendered pages and modern head registries while still accepting fully typed/rendered legacy records.
Do not call _vault twice or reread a Vault path outside the retained snapshot; final safety verification must cover Vault, generation and fixed cache groups even after a parser or limit failure.
Do not use state.profile or caller-supplied rows as authority without asserting exact producer identity sets, evidence ordinals, foreign keys, coverage cardinality and complete ancestry.
Do not canonicalize documents.json_text, source ledger rows, association/decision documents or original wire evidence; preserve exact original bytes/optional-key spelling.
Do not hash only the new projection modules: generation binds all installed video_paper_wiki Python files recursively and the complete canonical schema resource registry.
Do not allow resource readers to fall through to CWD or reread a path after a retained descriptor has been captured.
Do not let a valid self-hash cache authorize omission or invention; status, lookup, query and resolve reconstruct current state and compare exact canonical bytes.

Do not map legacy PDF contextual bbox floats to text offsets. Resolve only the exact parser JSON pointer/page/text/charspan contract; absent optional charspan is the fixed unsupported reason legacy_charspan_unavailable.
Do not make display selection the citation authority: a historical association remains resolvable while its own bytes, registration proof and history remain intact.

Do not treat registered-unclaimed sources, captured-unregistered files, or derived-unreferenced historical files as malformed when their complete validated ancestry is intact; represent their fixed coverage states.

review_status.reason: The frozen R1/R2/R3 mapping is concrete, but the generation/resource context gap must be closed and separately reviewed before catalog implementation can claim that retained bytes are the bytes consumed by the live schema/taxonomy readers.
